name: bible-song-pro
description: Bible Song Pro - Professional Church Presentation & Streaming Software
author: Bible Song Pro Team

scripts.start: npm run build:renderer && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; electron .
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:renderer && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; electron .
scripts.verify:dist-audience-display: npm run build:renderer && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && electron scripts/verify-dist-audience-display.cjs
scripts.verify:display-all: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:display-architecture && npm run verify:window-resizing && npm run verify:display-stack && npm run verify:dist-audience-display
scripts.verify:all: npm run test:live-scripture && npm run verify:remote-architecture && npm run verify:display-all

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro needs microphone access for live speech transcription and voice audio input.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro needs camera access for video capture and live feeds.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro needs screen capture access to project presentation displays.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro uses the local network to broadcast NDI video and connect stage and remote displays.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro needs access to your Desktop to import presentation media, videos, and graphics.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro needs access to your Documents folder to save and load service projects and song libraries.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Bible Song Pro needs access to your Downloads folder to import media assets and Bible translations.
